business_process: Real-time gas control of PS-1, PS-2, and JV-1 to JV-3
description: Controllers at GCC-1 monitor and control pressures, flows, compressor set-points, and remote valves through SCADA; GCC-2 is the hot standby
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Public safety (loss of remote valve control and alarms); 192.631 duties; about 9.5 billion cubic feet per day of firm service; manual operation can hold steady state for about 4 hours before curtailment is needed
manual_workaround: Fail over to GCC-2 (hot standby); manual operation by station operators and field crews following the manual operation plan (192.631(c)(3)); reduce pressure to widen safety margins
dependent_systems: SYS-01; SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-06; SYS-07 (OT identity)
dependent_third_parties: SCADA software vendor; two MPLS carriers; satellite backup provider; cellular carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: About 150 qualified controllers; station operators; GCC-1 and GCC-2 facilities
quantified_impact_basis: Reservation charge credits on firm service curtailed by about 50% (about $5.9 million) plus manual operation overtime and crew dispatch (about $0.9 million)
ps3_or_jv_dependency: JV-1 to JV-3 are controlled on the same SCADA; PS-3 is separate (BP-03)
single_points_of_failure: SCADA platform common to both GCCs (a software fault or compromise affects both)

description: Unit and station control, start and stop sequences, station alarms, local operation when SCADA is lost
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Compression sets line pack and delivery pressure; staffed local operation is possible at 61 stations, the other 35 need dispatched crews
manual_workaround: Local station operation from station HMIs or panels; dispatch crews to unstaffed stations; unit-by-unit manual starts
dependent_third_parties: Compression equipment manufacturers; electric utilities (12 electric-driven stations)
quantified_impact_basis: Lost throughput on constrained segments (about $2.6 million of reservation credits) plus crew overtime and travel (about $0.5 million)
ps3_or_jv_dependency: 8 PS-3 stations run legacy controls on flat networks
single_points_of_failure: End-of-support station HMIs at 22 stations; one manufacturer for turbine monitoring

business_process: PS-3 gas control (legacy control room PS3-CR)
description: Controllers at PS3-CR monitor and control the 2,100-mile PS-3 system on the legacy SCADA until migration to GCC-1
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Public safety and 192.631 duties; no hot standby, so loss of PS3-CR forces manual operation at once
manual_workaround: Manual operation by PS-3 station operators and field crews; PS-3 controllers relocate to a reserved GCC-2 desk with view-only access (no control)
dependent_third_parties: PS-3 legacy SCADA vendor; one MPLS carrier (PS-3 has a single carrier)
quantified_impact_basis: Reservation credits on PS-3 firm service curtailed by about 60% (about $1.6 million) plus manual operation costs (about $0.3 million)
single_points_of_failure: PS3-CR is a single control room with no hot standby; single MPLS carrier for PS-3

business_process: Pipeline emergency response and public safety communications
description: Receiving notices of potential rupture or leak, controller and field response, liaison with 9-1-1 centers and emergency officials (192.615)
process_owner: Vice President, Pipeline Safety and Compliance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Life safety; 192.615(a)(2), (a)(8), and (a)(12); no tolerance for loss of the ability to receive and act on emergency calls
manual_workaround: Toll-free emergency line rings to GCC-1 and GCC-2 and forwards to an answering service; field radio; satellite phones at GCCs and stations
dependent_third_parties: Telephone carrier; emergency line answering service
dependent_people_or_facilities: Controllers; on-call field supervisors; public awareness team
quantified_impact_basis: Answering service surge and overtime; safety and reputation impacts dominate and are not monetized
ps3_or_jv_dependency: PS-3 emergency line rings only at PS3-CR (forwarding to GCC-1 added 2026-06)

description: Shippers submit nominations each gas day; schedulers confirm with interconnecting pipelines and set scheduled quantities used by gas control
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Gas day nomination cycles; scheduled quantities drive gas control set-points; shippers and interconnects rely on timely confirmations; SL-1 commitments
manual_workaround: Roll forward prior-day scheduled quantities; accept nominations by secure email and phone with dual-entry verification; confirm with interconnects by phone
dependent_systems: SYS-09; SYS-07 (IT identity); SYS-08 (Cloud provider A)
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; interconnecting pipelines; electronic data interchange service
quantified_impact_basis: Imbalance and scheduling penalties waived under the tariff, manual scheduling labor, and shipper claims (about $1.9 million) plus lost interruptible revenue (about $0.5 million)
ps3_or_jv_dependency: JV pipelines use the same platform
single_points_of_failure: Single platform instance in Cloud provider A with a warm standby region

description: Flow computers and gas chromatographs measure volume and quality at about 1,480 meter stations; data flows through the DMZ to the measurement system
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Flow computers keep at least 35 days of data, so no data is lost; measurement closes daily for scheduling and monthly for invoicing
manual_workaround: Field collection from flow computers; estimate from SCADA volumes and correct later
quantified_impact_basis: Estimation and prior-period adjustment labor; dispute handling
ps3_or_jv_dependency: PS-3 meters on the legacy SCADA feed a separate interface

description: Computational pipeline monitoring, the AI-001 anomaly model, and integrity analytics give controllers advisory alerts; SCADA alarms stay primary
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Advisory tools only; SCADA alarms, patrols, and leakage surveys continue; loss reduces early warning
manual_workaround: Controllers rely on SCADA alarms and pressure trends; increase patrol frequency on high-consequence segments
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; leak model vendor
ps3_or_jv_dependency: AI-001 is not yet validated on PS-3
single_points_of_failure: One-way historian feed through the GCC-1 DMZ

business_process: Contract operations services for JV pipelines (SL-2)
description: Operator-of-record services for JV-1 to JV-3: monthly operating reports, measurement statements, compliance records, and owner data portal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Operating agreements set reporting deadlines and owner access commitments (SL-2)
manual_workaround: Send statements by secure file transfer; owner calls
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; Cloud provider B
quantified_impact_basis: Operating agreement service credits and staff time

description: Tariff-required postings of available capacity, notices, and capacity release transactions on the informational posting website
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tariff and FERC posting obligations; critical notices to shippers during operational events
manual_workaround: Post critical notices by email blast to shippers; manual capacity release log
quantified_impact_basis: Manual processing and possible shipper complaints
ps3_or_jv_dependency: JV pipelines use the same postings site

description: Monthly invoices for reservation and usage charges, imbalance accounting, and remittance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash, not time: invoicing runs in a 5-business-day window each month; each day of delay in that window defers about $13 million of collections
manual_workaround: Issue invoices from prior-month templates and true up; manual remittance posting
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; ERP vendor; bank
quantified_impact_basis: About $400 million invoiced each month; a day of delay in the invoicing window defers about $13 million (deferral, not loss)
ps3_or_jv_dependency: JV statements depend on the same system

business_process: Field work management, dispatch, and operator qualification records
description: Work orders, crew dispatch, maintenance records, and operator qualification status for covered tasks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Crews must be qualified for covered tasks; emergency dispatch must continue
manual_workaround: Paper work orders; radio dispatch; printed qualification rosters refreshed weekly
dependent_third_parties: Work management SaaS vendor; learning system vendor
ps3_or_jv_dependency: PS-3 crews still on a separate work management tool

business_process: Regulatory and security reporting (PHMSA, FERC, TSA, SEC event filings)
description: Capability to make telephonic and electronic notices and filings within required clocks
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Short clocks: 1 hour (191.5), 72 hours (SD 01G Section II.C), 4 business days (Item 1.05). Phone and out-of-band methods meet the shortest clocks
manual_workaround: Phone notices from the incident binder; filings from a clean workstation in the recovery environment
quantified_impact_basis: Regulatory exposure dominates and is not monetized

description: Monthly close, consolidation, and quarterly and annual SEC filings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SEC filing deadlines; the MTD drops to 48 hours in the quarter-end window
manual_workaround: Prior-period templates; manual journal entries with dual approval

description: Pay for 12,000 employees, including field overtime
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Wage payment laws; employee trust during an incident
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior pay period and true up
ps3_or_jv_dependency: PS-3 employees moved to company payroll in 2025

description: Business communications for all staff (not used for gas control commands)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Coordination and shipper communication; incident communication moves out of band
manual_workaround: Company mobile phones; out-of-band conferencing; printed contact lists

business_process: Engineering, GIS, and integrity data management
description: Pipeline records, maps, engineering drawings, integrity assessment data, FERC Form No. 567 data (CEII)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records needed for planning and annual filings; field crews carry offline map copies
manual_workaround: Offline map packages on field tablets; last exported records
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; GIS software vendor

description: Purchasing and inventory of pipe, valves, and compressor parts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Emergency purchases can be made by phone and card
manual_workaround: Emergency purchase by phone with after-the-fact entry
